versos.grego: Ἐπειδήπερ πολλοὶ ἐπεχείρησαν ἀνατάξασθαι διήγησιν περὶ τῶν πεπληροφορημένων ἐν ἡμῖν πραγμάτων,

controles.web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
controles.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
controles.livre: Como muitos empreenderam pôr em ordem o relato das coisas que entre nós se cumpriram,

versos.grego: καθὼς παρέδοσαν ἡμῖν οἱ ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς αὐτόπται καὶ ὑπηρέται γενόμενοι τοῦ λόγου,

controles.web: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,
controles.kjv: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
controles.livre: conforme os que as viram que desde o princípio, e foram servidores das palavra, nos transmitiram,

versos.grego: ἔδοξε κἀμοὶ παρηκολουθηκότι ἄνωθεν πᾶσιν ἀκριβῶς καθεξῆς σοι γράψαι, κράτιστε Θεόφιλε,

controles.web: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;
controles.kjv: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
controles.livre: pareceu-me bom que também eu, que tenho me informado com exatidão desde o princípio, escrevesse-as em ordem a ti, caríssimo Teófilo,

versos.grego: ἵνα ἐπιγνῷς περὶ ὧν κατηχήθης λόγων τὴν ἀσφάλειαν.

controles.web: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.
controles.kjv: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
controles.livre: para que conheças a certeza das coisas de que foste ensinado.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἡρῴδου βασιλέως τῆς Ἰουδαίας ἱερεύς τις ὀνόματι Ζαχαρίας ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά, καὶ γυνὴ αὐτῷ ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Ἀαρών, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Ἐλεισάβετ.

controles.web: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
controles.kjv: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
controles.livre: Houve nos dias de Herodes, rei da Judeia, um sacerdote chamado Zacarias, da ordem de Abias; sua mulher das filhas de Arão, e o seu nome era Isabel.

versos.grego: ἦσαν δὲ δίκαιοι ἀμφότεροι ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ, πορευόμενοι ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐντολαῖς καὶ δικαιώμασιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἄμεμπτοι.

controles.web: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
controles.kjv: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
controles.livre: E ambos eram justos diante de Deus; andavam sem repreensão em todos os mandamentos e preceitos do Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς τέκνον, καθότι ἦν ἡ Ἐλεισάβετ στεῖρα, καὶ ἀμφότεροι προβεβηκότες ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῶν ἦσαν.

controles.web: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
controles.kjv: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
controles.livre: Mas não tinham filho, porque Isabel era estéril, e ambos tinham idade avançada.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἱερατεύειν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ τάξει τῆς ἐφημερίας αὐτοῦ ἔναντι τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his course,
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando ele fazia o trabalho sacerdotal diante de Deus, na ordem da sua turma,

versos.grego: κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἱερατείας ἔλαχε τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὸν ναὸν τοῦ Κυρίου,

controles.web: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
controles.kjv: According to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
controles.livre: conforme o costume do sacerdócio, foi sorteado a entrar no santuário do Senhor para oferecer o incenso.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος ἦν τοῦ λαοῦ προσευχόμενον ἔξω τῇ ὥρᾳ τοῦ θυμιάματος.

controles.web: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.
controles.kjv: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
controles.livre: E toda a multidão do povo estava fora orando, à hora do incenso.

versos.grego: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος Κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τοῦ θυμιάματος.

controles.web: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
controles.kjv: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
controles.livre: Então um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu em pé, à direita do altar do incenso.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐταράχθη Ζαχαρίας ἰδών, καὶ φόβος ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ’ αὐτόν.

controles.web: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.
controles.kjv: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
controles.livre: Quando Zacarias o viu, perturbou-se, e o medo o tomou.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ ἄγγελος Μὴ φοβοῦ, Ζαχαρία, διότι εἰσηκούσθη ἡ δέησίς σου, καὶ ἡ γυνή σου Ἐλεισάβετ γεννήσει υἱόν σοι, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰωάνην·

controles.web: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.
controles.kjv: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
controles.livre: Mas o anjo lhe disse: Zacarias, não temas, pois a tua oração foi ouvida. E Isabel, tua mulher, dará à luz um filho, e lhe porás o nome de João.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσται χαρά σοι καὶ ἀγαλλίασις, καὶ πολλοὶ ἐπὶ τῇ γενέσει αὐτοῦ χαρήσονται.

controles.web: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
controles.livre: E terás prazer e alegria, e muitos se alegrarão do seu nascimento;

versos.grego: ἔσται γὰρ μέγας ἐνώπιον Κυρίου, καὶ οἶνον καὶ σίκερα οὐ μὴ πίῃ, καὶ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου πλησθήσεται ἔτι ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.
controles.kjv: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother’s womb.
controles.livre: pois ele será grande diante do Senhor, e não beberá vinho nem bebida alcoólica, e será cheio do Espírito Santo, já desde o ventre da sua mãe.

versos.grego: καὶ πολλοὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν αὐτῶν·

controles.web: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.
controles.kjv: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
controles.livre: E converterá muitos dos filhos de Israel ao Senhor seu Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτὸς προελεύσεται ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ δυνάμει Ἡλεία, ἐπιστρέψαι καρδίας πατέρων ἐπὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀπειθεῖς ἐν φρονήσει δικαίων, ἑτοιμάσαι Κυρίῳ λαὸν κατεσκευασμένον.

controles.web: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”
controles.kjv: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
controles.livre: E irá adiante dele no espírito e virtude de Elias, para converter os corações dos pais aos filhos, e os rebeldes à prudência dos justos; a fim de preparar um povo pronto ao Senhor.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν Ζαχαρίας πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον Κατὰ τί γνώσομαι τοῦτο; ἐγὼ γάρ εἰμι πρεσβύτης καὶ ἡ γυνή μου προβεβηκυῖα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”
controles.kjv: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
controles.livre: Então Zacarias disse ao anjo: Como terei certeza disso? Pois sou velho, e a minha mulher de idade avançada.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐγώ εἰμι Γαβριὴλ ὁ παρεστηκὼς ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ ἀπεστάλην λαλῆσαι πρὸς σὲ καὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαί σοι ταῦτα·

controles.web: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.
controles.kjv: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
controles.livre: O anjo lhe respondeu: Eu sou Gabriel, que fico presente diante de Deus, e fui enviado para te falar e te dar estas boas notícias.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔσῃ σιωπῶν καὶ μὴ δυνάμενος λαλῆσαι ἄχρι ἧς ἡμέρας γένηται ταῦτα, ἀνθ’ ὧν οὐκ ἐπίστευσας τοῖς λόγοις μου, οἵτινες πληρωθήσονται εἰς τὸν καιρὸν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”
controles.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
controles.livre: Eis que ficarás mudo, e não poderás falar até o dia em que essas coisas aconteçam, porque não creste nas minhas palavras, que se cumprirão no devido tempo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ὁ λαὸς προσδοκῶν τὸν Ζαχαρίαν, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐν τῷ χρονίζειν ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτόν.

controles.web: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.
controles.kjv: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
controles.livre: E o povo estava esperando Zacarias, e se surpreenderam de que ele demorava no santuário.

versos.grego: ἐξελθὼν δὲ οὐκ ἐδύνατο λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι ὀπτασίαν ἑώρακεν ἐν τῷ ναῷ· καὶ αὐτὸς ἦν διανεύων αὐτοῖς, καὶ διέμενεν κωφός.

controles.web: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.
controles.kjv: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
controles.livre: Quando ele saiu, não conseguia lhes falar; e entenderam que havia tido alguma visão no santuário. Ele lhes fazia gestos, e continuou mudo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐπλήσθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς λειτουργίας αὐτοῦ, ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
controles.livre: E sucedeu que, terminados os dias do seu serviço, voltou à sua casa.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ ταύτας τὰς ἡμέρας συνέλαβεν Ἐλεισάβετ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ, καὶ περιέκρυβεν ἑαυτὴν μῆνας πέντε, λέγουσα

controles.web: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,
controles.kjv: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
controles.livre: E depois daqueles dias Isabel, sua mulher, Isabel, engravidou-se, e por cinco meses se escondeu, dizendo:

versos.grego: ὅτι Οὕτως μοι πεποίηκεν Κύριος ἐν ἡμέραις αἷς ἐπεῖδεν ἀφελεῖν ὄνειδός μου ἐν ἀνθρώποις.

controles.web: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
controles.kjv: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
controles.livre: Pois isto o Senhor me fez nos dias em que ele me olhou, para acabar a minha humilhação entre as pessoas.

versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ ἀπεστάλη ὁ ἄγγελος Γαβριὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς πόλιν τῆς Γαλιλαίας ᾗ ὄνομα Ναζαρὲθ,

controles.web: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
controles.kjv: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
controles.livre: E no sexto mês o anjo Gabriel foi enviado da parte de Deus a uma cidade da Galileia, chamada Nazaré,

versos.grego: πρὸς παρθένον ἐμνηστευμένην ἀνδρὶ ᾧ ὄνομα Ἰωσὴφ, ἐξ οἴκου Δαυείδ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς παρθένου Μαριάμ.

controles.web: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin’s name was Mary.
controles.kjv: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin’s name was Mary.
controles.livre: a uma virgem prometida em casamento com um homem chamado José, da descendência  de Davi; e o nome da virgem era Maria.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσελθὼν πρὸς αὐτὴν εἶπεν Χαῖρε, κεχαριτωμένη, ὁ Κύριος μετὰ σοῦ.

controles.web: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”
controles.kjv: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
controles.livre: O anjo entrou onde ela estava, e disse: Alegra-te, agraciada; o Senhor é contigo.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ διεταράχθη, καὶ διελογίζετο ποταπὸς εἴη ὁ ἀσπασμὸς οὗτος.

controles.web: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.
controles.kjv: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
controles.livre: Ela perturbou-se muito por essas palavras, e se perguntava que saudação seria esta.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ἄγγελος αὐτῇ Μὴ φοβοῦ, Μαριάμ· εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ Θεῷ·

controles.web: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
controles.kjv: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
controles.livre: Então o anjo lhe disse: Maria, não temas, porque encontraste graça diante de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ συλλήμψῃ ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ τέξῃ υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’
controles.kjv: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
controles.livre: E eis que em teu ventre conceberás, darás à luz um filho, e chamarás o seu nome de Jesus.

versos.grego: οὗτος ἔσται μέγας καὶ Υἱὸς Ὑψίστου κληθήσεται, καὶ δώσει αὐτῷ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τὸν θρόνον Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,
controles.kjv: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
controles.livre: Ele será grande, e será chamado Filho do Altíssimo; e o Senhor Deus lhe dará o trono de Davi, seu ancestral.

versos.grego: καὶ βασιλεύσει ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰακὼβ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, καὶ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔσται τέλος.

controles.web: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”
controles.kjv: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
controles.livre: E reinará eternamente na casa de Jacó; o seu reino não terá fim.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριὰμ πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον Πῶς ἔσται τοῦτο, ἐπεὶ ἄνδρα οὐ γινώσκω;

controles.web: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”
controles.kjv: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
controles.livre: Maria disse ao anjo: Como será isso? Pois não conheço intimamente homem algum.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ ἄγγελος εἶπεν αὐτῇ Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον ἐπελεύσεται ἐπὶ σέ, καὶ δύναμις Ὑψίστου ἐπισκιάσει σοι· διὸ καὶ τὸ γεννώμενον ἅγιον κληθήσεται Υἱὸς Θεοῦ.

controles.web: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.
controles.kjv: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
controles.livre: O anjo lhe respondeu: O Espírito Santo virá sobre ti, e o poder do Altíssimo te cobrirá com a sua sombra. Por isso o Santo que nascerá será chamado Filho de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἐλεισάβετ ἡ συγγενίς σου καὶ αὐτὴ συνείληφεν υἱὸν ἐν γήρει αὐτῆς, καὶ οὗτος μὴν ἕκτος ἐστὶν αὐτῇ τῇ καλουμένῃ στείρᾳ·

controles.web: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
controles.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
controles.livre: E eis que Isabel, tua prima, também está grávida de um filho na sua velhice; e este é o sexto mês para a que era chamada de estéril.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὐκ ἀδυνατήσει παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ πᾶν ῥῆμα.

controles.web: For everything spoken by God is possible.”
controles.kjv: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
controles.livre: Pois para Deus nada será impossível.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ Μαριάμ Ἰδοὺ ἡ δούλη Κυρίου· γένοιτό μοι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου. καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτῆς ὁ ἄγγελος.

controles.web: Mary said, “Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word.”   The angel departed from her.
controles.kjv: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
controles.livre: Então Maria disse: Eis aqui a serva do Senhor; cumpra-se em mim conforme a tua palavra. E o anjo ausentou-se dela.

versos.grego: Ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ταύταις ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν μετὰ σπουδῆς εἰς πόλιν Ἰούδα,

controles.web: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,
controles.kjv: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
controles.livre: E naqueles dias, Maria levantou-se, e foi apressada à região montanhosa, a uma cidade de Judá.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ζαχαρίου καὶ ἠσπάσατο τὴν Ἐλεισάβετ.

controles.web: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
controles.kjv: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
controles.livre: Ela entrou na casa de Zacarias, e cumprimentou Isabel.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν τὸν ἀσπασμὸν τῆς Μαρίας ἡ Ἐλεισάβετ, ἐσκίρτησεν τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπλήσθη Πνεύματος Ἁγίου ἡ Ἐλεισάβετ,

controles.web: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando Isabel ouviu o cumprimento de Maria, a criança saltou no seu ventre, e Isabel foi cheia do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀνεφώνησεν κραυγῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ εἶπεν Εὐλογημένη σὺ ἐν γυναιξίν, καὶ εὐλογημένος ὁ καρπὸς τῆς κοιλίας σου.

controles.web: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
controles.kjv: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
controles.livre: Então exclamou em alta voz: Bendita és tu entre as mulheres, e bendito é o fruto do teu ventre!

versos.grego: καὶ πόθεν μοι τοῦτο ἵνα ἔλθῃ ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Κυρίου μου πρὸς ἐμέ;

controles.web: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
controles.kjv: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
controles.livre: Como me acontece isto,  que a mãe de meu Senhor venha a mim?

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡ φωνὴ τοῦ ἀσπασμοῦ σου εἰς τὰ ὦτά μου, ἐσκίρτησεν ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει τὸ βρέφος ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ μου.

controles.web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
controles.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
controles.livre: Pois eis que, quando a voz do teu cumprimento chegou aos meus ouvidos, a criança saltou de alegria no meu ventre.

versos.grego: καὶ μακαρία ἡ πιστεύσασα ὅτι ἔσται τελείωσις τοῖς λελαλημένοις αὐτῇ παρὰ Κυρίου.

controles.web: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”
controles.kjv: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
controles.livre: E bendita  a que creu, pois se cumprirão as coisas que do Senhor lhe foram ditas.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἶπεν Μαριάμ Μεγαλύνει ἡ ψυχή μου τὸν Κύριον,

controles.web: Mary said,  “My soul magnifies the Lord.
controles.kjv: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
controles.livre: Então Maria disse: A minha alma engrandece ao Senhor,

versos.grego: καὶ ἠγαλλίασεν τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ τῷ Σωτῆρί μου·

controles.web: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
controles.kjv: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
controles.livre: e o meu espírito se alegra em Deus meu Salvador.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῆς δούλης αὐτοῦ. ἰδοὺ γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν μακαριοῦσίν με πᾶσαι αἱ γενεαί·

controles.web: for he has looked at the humble state of his handmaid. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
controles.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
controles.livre: Porque ele olhou para a humilde condição da sua serva; pois eis que desde agora todas as gerações me chamarão bendita.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐποίησέν μοι μεγάλα ὁ δυνατός. καὶ ἅγιον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.
controles.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
controles.livre: Pois o Poderoso me fez grandes coisas; e santo é o seu nome.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γενεὰς τοῖς φοβουμένοις αὐτόν.

controles.web: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
controles.kjv: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
controles.livre: E a sua misericórdia é de geração em geração sobre os que o temem.

versos.grego: Ἐποίησεν κράτος ἐν βραχίονι αὐτοῦ, διεσκόρπισεν ὑπερηφάνους διανοίᾳ καρδίας αὐτῶν·

controles.web: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
controles.kjv: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
controles.livre: Com o seu braço manifestou poder; dispersou os soberbos no pensamento dos seus corações.

versos.grego: καθεῖλεν δυνάστας ἀπὸ θρόνων καὶ ὕψωσεν ταπεινούς,

controles.web: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.
controles.kjv: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
controles.livre: Derrubou os poderosos dos tronos, e elevou os humildes.

versos.grego: πεινῶντας ἐνέπλησεν ἀγαθῶν καὶ πλουτοῦντας ἐξαπέστειλεν κενούς.

controles.web: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.
controles.kjv: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
controles.livre: Encheu de bens aos famintos, e despediu vazios os ricos.

versos.grego: ἀντελάβετο Ἰσραὴλ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ, μνησθῆναι ἐλέους,

controles.web: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
controles.kjv: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
controles.livre: Auxiliou ao seu servo Israel, lembrando-se da sua misericórdia,

versos.grego: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν, τῷ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his seed forever.”
controles.kjv: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
controles.livre: como falou aos nossos ancestrais,  a Abraão, e à sua descendência,  para sempre.

versos.grego: Ἔμεινεν δὲ Μαριὰμ σὺν αὐτῇ ὡς μῆνας τρεῖς, καὶ ὑπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.
controles.kjv: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
controles.livre: Maria esteve com ela por quase três meses; então voltou para sua casa.

versos.grego: Τῇ δὲ Ἐλεισάβετ ἐπλήσθη ὁ χρόνος τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν, καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱόν.

controles.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
controles.kjv: Now Elisabeth’s full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
controles.livre: E completou-se à Isabel o tempo de dar à luz, e teve um filho.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ περίοικοι καὶ οἱ συγγενεῖς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐμεγάλυνεν Κύριος τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ μετ’ αὐτῆς, καὶ συνέχαιρον αὐτῇ.

controles.web: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.
controles.kjv: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
controles.livre: Os seus vizinhos e parentes ouviram que o Senhor havia feito a ela grande misericórdia, e alegraram-se com ela.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἦλθον περιτεμεῖν τὸ παιδίον, καὶ ἐκάλουν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαχαρίαν.

controles.web: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of the father.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ao oitavo dia vieram circuncidar o menino, e o chamavam Zacarias, do nome do seu pai.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν Οὐχί, ἀλλὰ κληθήσεται Ἰωάνης.

controles.web: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”
controles.kjv: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
controles.livre: E sua mãe respondeu: Não, porém será chamado João.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτὴν ὅτι Οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου ὃς καλεῖται τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ.

controles.web: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
controles.kjv: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
controles.livre: E disseram-lhe: Ninguém há entre os teus parentes que se chame deste nome.

versos.grego: ἐνένευον δὲ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ τί ἂν θέλοι καλεῖσθαι αὐτό.

controles.web: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.
controles.kjv: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
controles.livre: E perguntaram por gestos ao seu pai como queria que lhe chamassem.

versos.grego: καὶ αἰτήσας πινακίδιον ἔγραψεν λέγων Ἰωάνης ἐστὶν ὄνομα αὐτοῦ. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν πάντες.

controles.web: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.”   They all marveled.
controles.kjv: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
controles.livre: Ele pediu uma tábua, e escreveu: O seu nome é João. E todos se surpeenderam.

versos.grego: ἀνεῴχθη δὲ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ παραχρῆμα καὶ ἡ γλῶσσα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐλάλει εὐλογῶν τὸν Θεόν.

controles.web: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.
controles.kjv: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
controles.livre: E logo a sua boca se abriu, e a sua língua se soltou ; e voltou a falar, louvando a Deus.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ πάντας φόβος τοὺς περιοικοῦντας αὐτούς, καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ὀρεινῇ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διελαλεῖτο πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα,

controles.web: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.
controles.kjv: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judea.
controles.livre: E veio temor sobre todos os seus vizinhos; e em toda a região montanhosa da Judeia todas essas coisas foram divulgadas.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔθεντο πάντες οἱ ἀκούσαντες ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν, λέγοντες Τί ἄρα τὸ παιδίον τοῦτο ἔσται; καὶ γὰρ χεὶρ Κυρίου ἦν μετ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.
controles.kjv: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
controles.livre: E todos os que ouviam, guardavam em seus corações, dizendo: Quem será este menino? Pois também a mão do Senhor estava com ele.

versos.grego: Καὶ Ζαχαρίας ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐπλήσθη Πνεύματος Ἁγίου καὶ ἐπροφήτευσεν λέγων

controles.web: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
controles.kjv: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
controles.livre: E Zacarias, seu pai, foi cheio do Espírito Santo, e profetizou, dizendo:

versos.grego: Εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, ὅτι ἐπεσκέψατο καὶ ἐποίησεν λύτρωσιν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and worked redemption for his people;
controles.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
controles.livre: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de Israel, porque visitou e redimiu o seu povo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἤγειρεν κέρας σωτηρίας ἡμῖν ἐν οἴκῳ Δαυεὶδ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
controles.kjv: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
controles.livre: E nos levantou uma poderosa salvação  na casa de seu servo Davi,

versos.grego: καθὼς ἐλάλησεν διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ’ αἰῶνος προφητῶν αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
controles.kjv: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
controles.livre: como falou pela boca dos seus santos profetas, desde o princípio do mundo;

versos.grego: σωτηρίαν ἐξ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν μισούντων ἡμᾶς,

controles.web: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all who hate us;
controles.kjv: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
controles.livre: Que nos livraria dos nossos inimigos e da mão de todos os que nos odeiam,

versos.grego: ποιῆσαι ἔλεος μετὰ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ μνησθῆναι διαθήκης ἁγίας αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: to show mercy towards our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
controles.kjv: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
controles.livre: para manifestar misericórdia aos nossos ancestrais,  e se lembrar do seu santo pacto,

versos.grego: ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσεν πρὸς Ἀβραὰμ τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν, τοῦ δοῦναι ἡμῖν

controles.web: the oath which he spoke to Abraham, our father,
controles.kjv: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
controles.livre: do juramento que fez a Abraão, nosso ancestral;

versos.grego: ἀφόβως ἐκ χειρὸς ἐχθρῶν ῥυσθέντας λατρεύειν αὐτῷ

controles.web: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
controles.kjv: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
controles.livre: de nos conceder que, libertos da mão dos inimigos, o serviríamos sem temor,

versos.grego: ἐν ὁσιότητι καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ πάσαις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἡμῶν.

controles.web: In holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
controles.kjv: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
controles.livre: em santidade e justiça diante dele, todos os nossos dias.

versos.grego: Καὶ σὺ δέ, παιδίον, προφήτης Ὑψίστου κληθήσῃ· προπορεύσῃ γὰρ ἐνώπιον Κυρίου ἑτοιμάσαι ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
controles.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
controles.livre: E tu, menino, serás chamado profeta do Altíssimo; porque irás adiante da face do Senhor, para preparar os seus caminhos,

versos.grego: τοῦ δοῦναι γνῶσιν σωτηρίας τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀφέσει ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν,

controles.web: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,
controles.kjv: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
controles.livre: para dar a seu povo conhecimento da salvação, na remissão de seus pecados;

versos.grego: διὰ σπλάγχνα ἐλέους Θεοῦ ἡμῶν, ἐν οἷς ἐπισκέψεται ἡμᾶς ἀνατολὴ ἐξ ὕψους,

controles.web: because of the tender mercy of our God, whereby the dawn from on high will visit us,
controles.kjv: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
controles.livre: por causa da profunda misericórdia  do nosso Deus, pela qual o raiar da manhã nos visitará;

versos.grego: ἐπιφᾶναι τοῖς ἐν σκότει καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου καθημένοις, τοῦ κατευθῦναι τοὺς πόδας ἡμῶν εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης.

controles.web: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”
controles.kjv: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
controles.livre: para iluminar os que estão sentados nas trevas e sombra de morte; a fim de guiar os nossos pés pelo caminho da paz.

versos.grego: Τὸ δὲ παιδίον ηὔξανεν καὶ ἐκραταιοῦτο πνεύματι, καὶ ἦν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις ἕως ἡμέρας ἀναδείξεως αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν Ἰσραήλ.

controles.web: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
controles.kjv: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
controles.livre: E o menino crescia e se fortalecia em espírito. E esteve nos desertos até o dia em que se mostrou a Israel.
